name: Set appearance 17650 Rosethorn Rites of the Hexflame Coven expands into nine distinct slots (#4206)
contract: Appearances.dbc row 17650 is category 55 (item set) with SourceItem 61212 (ItemSet.dbc 'Rosethorn Rites of the Hexflame Coven'). Its nine pieces (157159 head, 157160 shoulders, 157161 cloak, 157162 robe/chest, 157171 hands, 157168 feet, 157165 waist, 157166 legs, 157167 wrists; item_template InventoryType confirms each slot) all resolve through ItemAppearances.dbc to an appearance whose own PrimaryCategory is 1 (Head), so applying category 55 used to collapse the whole set into category 1 and leave the other eight empty. ExpandItemSetAppearance now derives the category from each piece's ItemTemplate::InventoryType when the DBC category does not match the real slot, so the nine pieces land in nine distinct categories (1 head, 2 shoulders, 3 cloak, 4 chest, 7 wrists, 8 hands, 9 waist, 10 legs, 11 feet) instead of all competing for category 1. CoA.UnlockLocalAppearanceCatalog defaults to on, so the character already has every appearance collected without a fixture. SMSG_APPEARANCE_ACTIVE_INFO (opcode 1690) carries the full active-appearance array indexed by category (word index 0 is the array length, word index category+1 is that category's appearance id); it is resent on login, so a relog proves the expansion persisted through character_appearance rather than only existing in memory.

steps.label: Reload so the saved expansion resends on login
Wrists (category 7) show the wrist piece, not left empty
Hands (category 8) show the hand piece, not left empty
Waist (category 9) shows the waist piece, not left empty
Legs (category 10) show the leg piece, not left empty
Feet (category 11) show the feet piece, not left empty
